title: GitHub - croffasia/itsaplan: Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Linear. Project management and issue tracking where teams and AI agents work side by side to plan and ship products.
excerpt: Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Linear. Project management and issue tracking where teams and AI agents work side by side to plan and ship products. - croffasia/itsaplan
content_html:
Open-source project management and issue tracking, with AI agents built in

Self-hosted, open-source project management and issue tracking, and an alternative to Linear, Plane, and Jira. The difference: AI agents work here like any teammate. Hand them issues, or run the whole thing over the REST API, webhooks, and MCP.

If It's a Plan looks useful to you, star the repo ⭐ — it helps other people find it.

Website · Discussions · Contributing · Security

About

Most trackers bolt AI on as a chatbot. Here an agent is a real member of the team. It has a role, permissions, and an assignee slot, and it works the same board your people do.

It's a self-hosted, open alternative to Linear, Plane, and Jira. You run it on your own server and database.

  • Own your stack. Your server, your database. No per-seat fees, no lock-in.
  • Agents as teammates. Give an agent a model, a prompt, skills, and tools. Assign it issues like you would a person.
  • One board for both. People and agents share the same board, threads, and cards.
  • Automate anything. Drive it all through the REST API, MCP, and signed webhooks.

Heads-up: this is under active development. Expect breaking changes before the first stable release.

Features

Tracking

  • Configure issues per project: custom fields, labels, states, and issue types
  • Kanban, table, timeline, and calendar views, with configurable display fields and two-level grouping
  • Save any view as a reusable template
  • Configurable dashboards for project analytics: throughput, breakdown, pulse
  • Custom quick actions that run on an issue
  • Freeform notes boards: sticky notes on a canvas, with colors, checklists, and connections
  • Share a view or an issue by public link, read-only and without sign-in
  • Initiatives that group and track work across projects
  • Auto-archive, a notification inbox, role-based access control, and more

AI agents

  • Agents as project members with their own permissions and assigned issues
  • Configure each agent's model, system prompt, tools, and reusable skills — built on the Mastra agent framework
  • Mention an agent in a comment to trigger a run
  • Scheduled agent runs
  • Built-in chat with per-agent conversation history

Platform

  • REST API with an OpenAPI reference and API keys
  • MCP server, so an external assistant can read and change issues through the same API
  • Outgoing webhooks: subscribe to events, signed payloads, and retries with a delivery log
  • Email and password, passkey, and Google sign-in
  • Notifications by email (SMTP or Resend) and Telegram, with per-member preferences
  • Instance administration: storage limits, mail transport, and instance-wide settings

Getting started

Requirements: Docker and a domain behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy.

git clone https://github.com/croffasia/itsaplan.git
cd itsaplan
cp .env.example .env      # set API_URL, APP_URL, and the secrets
docker compose up -d --build

One command brings up the whole stack: Postgres, MinIO, api, worker, bot, and web. The first account registered becomes the instance admin.

  • Self-hosting — the full production setup, secrets, and updates
  • Deploy on Coolify — the same stack on a Coolify instance
  • Local development — running the apps on the host, and the tests

Built with

Layer Technology
Runtime Bun + Turborepo
Backend Elysia
Frontend Next.js App Router, SSR
UI shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4
Auth better-auth
Database Drizzle + PostgreSQL
Storage S3-compatible object store (MinIO)
AI agents Mastra 
apps/api        Elysia HTTP API, mounts better-auth at /api/auth/*
apps/web        Next.js app, server-side rendered
apps/worker     webhooks, notifications, agent runs
apps/bot        Telegram bot
packages/db     Drizzle client, schema, migrations
packages/auth   better-auth server instance
packages/crypto AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets at rest
packages/mailer SMTP and Resend transport

The web app never imports the packages directly, it talks to the API over HTTP.

More from us

Vibe Code Kit — a Claude Code plugin with 20+ expert skills that turn AI slop into senior-level code. It teaches your AI agent professional development and design practices, so you ship production-ready code on the first try. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.

It's a Plan is built with it — the code you are reading is the proof.

Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — bug fixes, features, docs, all of it. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md. It covers the setup, the conventions, and how a change gets merged. Be kind; we follow a Code of Conduct.

Not ready to contribute code? Star the repo and share it — it is the simplest way to help the project grow.

Security

Found a vulnerability? Report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories, not a public issue, so we can fix it first. Details in SECURITY.md.

content_html_zh:
开源项目管理和问题跟踪，内置人工智能代理

自托管、开源项目管理和问题跟踪，以及 Linear、Plane 和 Jira 的替代方案。 区别在于：人工智能代理在这里像任何队友一样工作。 将问题交给他们，或者通过 REST API、Webhooks 和 MCP 运行整个过程。

如果这是一个计划对您来说有用，请为该存储库加注星标 ⭐ - 它可以帮助其他人找到它。

网站·讨论·贡献·安全

About

大多数追踪器将人工智能作为聊天机器人。 这里的代理是团队的真正成员。 它有一个角色、权限和一个受让人位置，并且它的工作方式与您的员工的工作方式相同。

它是 Linear、Plane 和 Jira 的自托管、开放替代品。 您在自己的服务器和数据库上运行它。

  • 拥有你的堆栈。 您的服务器，您的数据库。 没有每个席位的费用，没有锁定。
  • 代理作为队友。 为代理提供模型、提示、技能和工具。 像分配一个人一样分配它。
  • 一块板供两者使用。 人员和代理共享相同的板、线程和卡。
  • 自动化任何事情。 通过 REST API、MCP 和签名的 Webhooks 来驱动这一切。

注意：该功能正在积极开发中。 在第一个稳定版本发布之前预计会有重大变化。

特征

追踪

  • 配置每个项目的问题：自定义字段、标签、状态和问题类型
  • 看板、表格、时间线和日历视图，具有可配置的显示字段和两级分组
  • 将任何视图保存为可重复使用的模板
  • 用于项目分析的可配置仪表板：吞吐量、故障、脉冲
  • 针对问题运行的自定义快速操作
  • 自由格式笔记板：画布上的便签，带有颜色、清单和连接
  • 通过公共链接共享视图或问题，只读且无需登录
  • 跨项目分组和跟踪工作的举措
  • 自动存档、通知收件箱、基于角色的访问控制等等

人工智能代理

  • 代理作为项目成员，拥有自己的权限和分配的问题
  • 配置每个代理的模型、系统提示、工具和可重用技能——基于 Mastra 代理框架构建
  • 在评论中提及代理以触发运行
  • 预定的代理运行
  • 内置聊天功能，包含每个客服人员的对话历史记录

平台

  • 带有 OpenAPI 参考和 API 密钥的 REST API
  • MCP 服务器，因此外部助手可以通过相同的 API 读取和更改问题
  • 传出 Webhooks：订阅事件、签名有效负载并使用传送日志重试
  • 电子邮件和密码、密钥和 Google 登录
  • 通过电子邮件（SMTP 或重新发送）和 Telegram 发送通知，并具有每个成员的偏好
  • 实例管理：存储限制、邮件传输和实例范围的设置

入门

要求：Docker 和 TLS 终止反向代理后面的域。

git clone https://github.com/croffasia/itsaplan.git
cd itsaplan
cp .env.example .env      # set API_URL, APP_URL, and the secrets
docker compose up -d --build

一个命令即可调出整个堆栈：Postgres、MinIO、api、worker、bot 和 web。 第一个注册的帐户成为实例管理员。

  • 自托管 — 完整的生产设置、秘密和更新
  • 在 Coolify 上部署 — Coolify 实例上的相同堆栈
  • 本地开发 - 在主机上运行应用程序和测试

内置

Layer 技术
运行时 面包+涡轮波雷波
后端 艾丽西亚
前端 Next.js 应用程序路由器、SSR
UI shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4
Auth 更好的认证
数据库 毛毛雨 + PostgreSQL
贮存 S3 兼容对象存储 (MinIO)
人工智能代理 掌握 
apps/api        Elysia HTTP API, mounts better-auth at /api/auth/*
apps/web        Next.js app, server-side rendered
apps/worker     webhooks, notifications, agent runs
apps/bot        Telegram bot
packages/db     Drizzle client, schema, migrations
packages/auth   better-auth server instance
packages/crypto AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets at rest
packages/mailer SMTP and Resend transport

Web 应用程序从不直接导入包，而是通过 HTTP 与 API 进行通信。

更多来自我们

Vibe Code Kit — 一个 Claude Code 插件，具有 20 多种专业技能，可将 AI slop 转化为高级代码。 它教授您的人工智能代理专业开发和设计实践，因此您可以在第一次尝试时交付可用于生产的代码。 可与 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 Cursor 配合使用。

这是一个用它构建的计划——您正在阅读的代码就是证明。

贡献

欢迎提出问题和拉取请求 - 错误修复、功能、文档，所有这些。 从 CONTRIBUTING.md 开始。 它涵盖了设置、约定以及如何合并更改。 保持友善；我们遵循行为准则。

还没准备好贡献代码吗？ 对存储库加注星标并进行分享——这是帮助项目发展的最简单方法。

安全

发现漏洞？ 通过 GitHub 安全咨询私下报告该问题，而不是公开问题，因此我们可以先修复它。 详细信息请参见 SECURITY.md。
